notes:
Accept after corrections made in place. The review was done by Claude Code (session cc-38267a) against the accepted manuscript (Cambridge repository, SHA-256 fb88e83c…), with three checkers (§§1–2, §§3–4, §§5–7). The coordinator verified every substantive finding. The published Duke text was not accessible. Corrections were made to 35 items. The material ones: items 006 and 013 had copied two errors of the paper (E6, E8); item 026's π_H is the packet of the (1, n−1) datum; item 048 had the ramification of π′_2 wrong. Two items were split so that each result has one owner. 25 items were added, giving 81 in total (17 planned, 64 missing), and four routes were added. Source issues: E1–E5 are confirmed, and E1's quotation was corrected. E6–E23 are new. The substantive ones:
- E7: a wrong entry in the n = 9 matrix T_{s₂}, so that as printed it does not define an H_B-module. Checked by hand and by a symbolic check of all the relations.
- E8: Theorem 2.4(a) as printed forces u = 1.
- E10: the 'unique irreducible submodule' claim in §3.5 is false (Y also embeds).
- E20: primitivity of r_{𝔭₀} is unproved.
- E21: Lemma 5.3 is proved only for unipotent conditions.
- E22: Theorem 6.2 lacks the hypothesis F(ζ_l) ⊄ F(ad ρ̄) needed for Theorem 5.7(4).
- E23: the descent in Theorem 7.1 is ambiguous up to η_{E/F}.
All have direct repairs, and none affects Theorem 1.1 or Corollaries 1.2–1.3 under their stated hypotheses.
